main_text.p: fes Monasteriorum Diaconus Choniata. En tibi quæréti gregem Schismaticorum, & globum Hæreticorum, tanquam qui Gregoram Palamam, & schismatis, & hæreseon Patronum pertinacissimum sequuntur, & illius male sanas opiniones tutantes, contrarias, rectas, atque integras oppugnant: hi omnes gregatim, conglobatimq; etiam perinviti, atque adversissimi, veritatis radio compulsi processionem Spiritus ex Filio confitentur, & additionem, cum suam defendere nituntur in Tomo Synodico probant. Si his non conquiescis, neque si Graecos alios omnes nemine excepto acervatim uno signo convenientes produxero, non conquiesces. Sed non puto te adeo litigiosum hominem esse. Hi itaque Schismatici in Tomo; Ἡ δὲ Θεία Σύνοδος ὀχώρισον μὲν ἰσομὴν ἔφη τῷ Θεῷ οὐσίαν, καὶ τὴν Θείαν, καὶ Φυσικὴν ἐνέργειαν. ἡ γὰρ ποτὲ ἐνέργεια ἂν ἀπὸ τῆς ἑαυτῆς οὐσίας χωρεῖς. ἆρα μὴ ἀρχῆς [?] τὸ Θεοῦ ἀδημιουργήματος [?] ἐν [?]. τῆς ἐκ οἰκίας, εἰμὴ καὶ Θεὸν ἀπολείπουσα τῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεοτόκοι [?], ὅν πῶν ἀδημιούργημα τῆς ἐνεργείας τὸ ἀδημιουργήσαντος, ἀλλ᾽ ἡ τῆς οὐσίας μεταλήψις [?]. ἡ δὲ εἰκόνα τῆς τὸ οἰκονομίας, ἡδὲ ταῦτ᾽ αὐτῆς ἀναγνωρίσεως μετείληφε [?] τῆς οὐσίας, ἀλλὰ τῆς τέχνης, καὶ τῆς ἐνεργείας καὶ τῶν Νύσσης θεολόγου. Sacra Synodus dixit, indimisam cognoscimus divinam essentiam, & sacram

page.notes: The Greek passages are hard to read on this scan. Words marked [?] are doubtful, and the Greek stretch from "ἆρα" to "θεολόγου" is a best reading and should be checked against the original. The Latin is clear except where noted. Printed spellings kept as printed: "Gregoram", "Palamam", "indimisam" (the printer's "indimisfam", with long s rendered as plain s), "perinviti" (printed "perinuiti"), and "non conquiesces" (printed "conquiesces"). The ligature-like letters in "esse" and "Schismatici" are shown with plain s. The last line ends in a hyphen, "sa-", and the catchword "cram" completes it.
